text:
jess-billing: FYI ran into a payment failure for Nectar (cust NECT-412). Invoice `INV-7890` attempted 3x, card declined each time. last4 4242. Any preferred fallback? :grimacing:

sam-finance: can you paste the decline code from our gateway? sometimes it's just expired/card-block. if it's 5xx we retry.

jess-billing: gateway shows `card_declined` + `insufficient_funds` on attempt 3, AVS passed. decline id `d_8f7a9`.

katie-cs: pinging Nectar to ask for updated payment method now, sending secure link. will update here if they respond. :white_check_mark:

sam-finance: ok. let's schedule one automated retry in 2 hours and then offer wire if it fails again. mark invoice with note "retry-scheduled". can you also confirm whether Nectar is on net-30 so we can waive late fees if we accept wire?

jess-billing: Nectar is on net-30 (sales@nectar). I'll add the note.

leo-ops: if we go wire, make sure we send full beneficiary name + account type check. last time bank rejected because account name didn't match invoice entity. template below.

leo-ops: ```Wire instructions (template):
Bank: First National Bank
Routing (ACH): xxxxxxxx
SWIFT: FNBOUS33
Account name: [Customer legal entity]
Account number: [masked until confirm]
Reference / Memo: INV-7890 / Redwood Inference
```

sam-finance: thanks. add this to the invoice email if we escalate. also request a small micro-deposit verification if they want ACH instead of wire.

katie-cs: customer replied — says their card is tied to an old card on file, they'll update in the next 24 hours or pay by ACH/wire today. asked which option is fastest.

sam-finance: fastest is wire. ask for confirmation of beneficiary legal name and whether the account is checking or savings. include note that we need exact match to avoid rejection.

jess-billing: sending revised payment options to customer now with the wire template and a secure link for card update. cc @sam-finance.

ops-bot: Scheduled retry for `INV-7890` at 1909008434 (2 hours).

sam-finance: if retry fails after the scheduled attempt, we'll prepare a manual invoice email with wire instructions and follow up with sales for approval to waive late fees. who owns approval? @maria-g (revenue ops) normally signs off on fee waivers.

katie-cs: noted, I'll escalate to Maria if they reply saying they can't update card.

jess-billing: logging this thread in the invoice history. tagging for audits: decline id `d_8f7a9`, retry scheduled id `r_1909008434`.

leo-ops: one more tip — when you paste the account number in the email, mask except last 4 and include a checksum line to reduce copy errors.

sam-finance: agreed. thanks everyone. will monitor and update after the retry. :thumbsup:
